analysis.drawingStrategy: Start with the wall so everything else has something to sit on, set the roof over it, then place the door and windows against the wall edges.

steps.title: Draw the front wall
steps.instruction: Draw a wide box across the middle of the page, a little wider than it is tall. Everything else sits on it.

steps.title: Set the roof on top
steps.instruction: Start just outside the left corner of the wall, rise to a point above its middle, and come down just past the right corner.

steps.title: Place the door
steps.instruction: The door stands on the bottom edge, in the middle, and reaches about halfway up the wall.

steps.title: Add the two windows
steps.instruction: Put one window on each side of the door, level with each other and a little above the top of the door.

steps.title: Finish with the chimney
steps.instruction: Stand a narrow chimney on the right-hand slope of the roof, its top a little lower than the roof's peak.
